candidates.title: Will the President's approval rating be below 37.9 according to RealClearPolitics?
candidates.rules_primary: If the President's approval rating is below 37.9% at 11:00 AM ET on November 20, 2026 according to RealClearPolitics, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The market will determine at 11:00 AM ET on November 20, 2026.

candidates.title: Will the maximum temperature be 68-69° on Nov 19, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the maximum temperature recorded at Chicago (CLIMDW) for Nov 19, 2026, is between 68-69° fahrenheit according to The Weather Company, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market is the maximum/minimum temperature as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

If it is determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange that there is a material error in the initial non-preliminary publication, Expiration may be held until the publication of a non-materially-erroneous data revision or until the Expiration Date, whichever comes first. If no data is available at the end of this period, all markets will resolve to the last fair price determined by Kalshi. Please note, a status of "Final" on weather.com/kalshi is provided for convenience only, and does not guarantee data to be error-free and thus exempt from the above.

candidates.title: Will the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for November 20, 2026 be above $1.50?
candidates.rules_primary: If the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, as reported in the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report scheduled for publication on November 20, 2026 is above $1.50, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market uses advertised retail prices, not transaction prices. The relevant value is the “This Week” Wtd Avg Price for the row with Commodity “Avocados,” Variety “Hass,” and Unit “each” in the National Conventional Summary section of the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report. Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.

candidates.title: Will Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: U.S. city average, All items, not seasonally adjusted, 1982–84=100 for November 2026 be above 336.700?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: U.S. city average, All items, not seasonally adjusted, 1982–84=100 for November 2026 is above 336.700, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The Underlying is the Bureau of Labor Statistics’ Consumer Price Index News Release Table 1 for November 2026. Specifically, the value used will be the “All items” value under the “Unadjusted indexes” column for November 2026. This market will resolve according to the first value published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics in the scheduled Consumer Price Index release for November 2026. Subsequent revisions will not affect the market.

candidates.title: Will there be at least 20 presidential nominations sent to the Senate in the week of Nov 15, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has sent at least 20 nominations to the U.S. Senate from Nov 15, 2026 through Nov 21, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov before 10:00 AM ET on Nov 22, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The market solely resolves to the publication dates visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov before 10:00 AM ET on Nov 22, 2026.
The week runs from Nov 15, 2026 through Nov 21, 2026.

Payout criteria

If a person receives multiple qualifying nominations within the period, they will each count separately.
For example, Trump's March 4 nomination of Kevin Warsh is considered two nominations.

candidates.title: Will Trump nominate Christopher Waller as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.rules_primary: If Christopher Waller is nominated as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027. then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: Official announcements made by the President (or President-elect) of Christopher Waller's nomination shall satisfy the Payout Criterion, even if they are not yet sent to the Senate.

candidates.title: Will year-over-year percentage change in U.S. electricity prices for November 2026 be above 3.4%?
candidates.rules_primary:
If the year-over-year percentage change in U.S. electricity prices for November 2026 is above 

3.4%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
“Year-over-year percentage change in U.S. electricity prices” means the unadjusted 12-month percent change for “Electricity” in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), U.S. city average, as published by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

Resolution uses the percentage change published in the first BLS CPI release reporting November 2026 data, at its published precision. The value will not be recalculated from index levels. Subsequent revisions will not affect resolution.

candidates.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2030 be above 4.0%?
candidates.rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2030 is above 4.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2030 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2030, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.
